subject: Biology

explain: There are 4 pairs of spermathecae in segments 6–9 of the earthworm.

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

explain: Ventral nerve cord has paired fused ganglia in each segment providing segmental control.

subject: Biology

explain: Cockroach (Periplaneta) belongs to class Insecta of phylum Arthropoda.

explain: Thorax of cockroach has three segments: pro-, meso- and metathorax.

subject: Biology
prompt: Frog belongs to which order?

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

explain: Fat bodies in frog store fat used as energy reserve during hibernation and reproduction.

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

explain: Mesothelium (coelomic epithelium) lines the coelom and forms the peritoneum per NCERT.

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology

subject: Biology
